prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func LeftCycle(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse canonical k;values where k is an unsigned decimal in 0..1000000 and values is a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed integers in -1000..1000. Rotate the list left by k modulo its length and return comma-separated values. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 7;10,20,30 returns 20,30,10.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
